method: Read-only Ghidra 12.1.2 pseudo-disassembly in the RE VM under the retained NDS32 instruction/data premise. Existing bounded direct-flow walk skips callees under assumed return. Halfword scans find candidates, not a complete data-flow or writer audit.

early_updates.condition: Frame-control masked by 0xfc equals beacon subtype 0x80.
Frame-control masked by 0xfc equals probe-response subtype 0x50.
After the selected packet diagnostic/log branch, before later management-processing gates.

receive_routine.scan_counter_gate: The later root-relative +0x2890 increment requires root mode +0x2370 equal zero and reaching that branch after intervening checks/callees. Earlier byte updates do not require reaching this increment.
receive_routine.reset_candidate: Selected scan-state graph contains zero stores to all three early bytes after setting root mode zero. This does not establish runtime execution or exclude other writers/resets.

context_selector.behavior: Modes 1 and 3 select root +0x3f84; other modes select root +0x2374.

management_helper.behavior: The selected helper returns zero unless root byte +0x3078 is nonzero and root mode +0x2370 equals 2, before further subtype/processing checks. This helper is not the sole gate on the ordinary scan counter.

reference_searches.behavior: Two data-pointer candidates reference the receive entry. The selected offset windows include early updates, scan-state resets and readers comparing current beacon/probe bytes with saved bytes. Callers and callback/table dispatch remain unresolved.

decision: Zero ordinary scan-management count cannot distinguish no entry into the selected receive routine from later processing rejection. Establish an earlier receive observation before changing filters, calibration or radio setup.
limitations: Eight-bit statistics wrap at 256. Unchanged samples cannot prove no receive activity without bounds on increments and reset/writer behavior.
Positive byte change alone is not a unique frame count, valid beacon, RF dwell measurement or host delivery proof.
No complete caller, table, callback, writer or bulk-reset audit; no live values from these early byte addresses have been queried.
